attributes._note: Classless build choice: every level beyond 1 grants points_per_level free points, spent once per Run (no respec). Attributes only feed derived values: stats (grants, like track growth), skill resources and skill power for matching skills. Effective values stay derived in CharacterStats.

list.name: Might
list.description: +1 Attack per point. Physical skills (neutral, metal, earth) gain 4% power per point.

list.name: Vitality
list.description: +4 Max HP per point and +1 Defense every 2 points.

list.name: Spirit
list.description: +3 max Energy per point. Elemental skills, healing and the statuses they apply gain 6% power per point.
